decision: OWNER 21:35 PT 10-14 (coordinator relay): the 4 VM slices hfd_hgi_vms_{SW,SE,NW,NE} may move 1,111 -> 833.333 ps (one die clock, C/V CDC crossers removed) for SU.VOP 32 sectors/engine edge; H-ELEM-B builds/closes the 833 variants; swap only once closed

die_clock.tree: clk_stream (833.333 ps, existing PLL output of hb_ckgen)
die_clock.finding: the v14 die model already clocks every slice pin hb_vms_<q>/ck from clk_stream (run23 clock plan EPYC1 hbmdie-v14/run23/sta/clock/plan.json: hb_vms_SW/ck region clk_stream_ck_stream_4682:HUB-C, SE 7133, NW 6071, NE 8427; die-level probe insertion 62.2-63.0 ps). No clk_serial / VM-domain pin reaches any slice in the die netlist, so a 1,111-ps slice could not have been bound as built; the 833 variant is the one the die delivers.
die_clock.per_slice_entry: die delivers phi - R at hb_vms_<q>/ck, R = the closed 833 view boundary insertion (TT, FF) from its insertion.json; recorded in the die child clock table when the view closes
die_clock.sink_rule: one clock root per slice with <= 15,000 sinks, else measured insertion <= 300 ps and spread <= 80 ps (owner 10-13); 32 ot_hgi_vm_wide_bank + glue
die_clock.sdc: slice <-> ring stations (2,148 b 2x2 ring), VM8 and lg* lane stations are clk_stream same-domain: fully timed, no exceptions; the removed C/V crossers delete their async groups; the SU-side ratio crossing stays inside the SU (unchanged)

slots.pins: same die ports and faces as the v14 assigned pin files (no new bits); a re-closed variant re-pins only if die STA/window names it
